description: This file defines internal traits and functions for uninitialized resizing and appending of std::string objects, with support for custom member functions if available.

classes.name: ResizeUninitializedTraits
classes.description: Type trait to determine if a string type has a __resize_default_init method and to provide a resize method accordingly.

classes.name: AppendUninitializedTraits
classes.description: Type trait to determine if a string type has a __append_default_init method and to provide an append method accordingly.

methods.name: STLStringSupportsNontrashingResize
methods.description: Checks if the string type supports uninitialized resize.

methods.name: STLStringResizeUninitialized
methods.description: Resizes a string to a new size, possibly leaving new characters uninitialized.

methods.name: STLStringReserveAmortized
methods.description: Reserves capacity for a string with exponential growth to optimize multiple resizes.

methods.name: STLStringResizeUninitializedAmortized
methods.description: Resizes a string with amortized growth, using append or erase.
